main.description: Get the requester's bookmarks of private-tier posts, newest bookmark first. Each post is read for the requester as getPosts reads it: a bookmarked post the requester may not read now (its audience no longer includes the requester, it was deleted, or it never existed) is omitted without distinction. Requires auth by a ready community member.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.
Present when more of the requester's bookmarks may follow. It walks the requester's bookmarks, not the posts, so a page may hold fewer than limit items, or none, and still carry a cursor.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
